tuning_key.text: So you can create or destroy
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: Every choice you make today is a frequency you're broadcasting into the field — and that frequency is already reshaping what becomes real around you. The scattered pieces of your life, your attention, your intention are not waiting to align someday; they align the moment you stop treating them as separate. Creation and destruction are the same act seen from different angles, and right now you're choosing which one you're building. The question isn't whether you have power — it's whether you're awake to the one you're already using.

practice.title: Locate the Choice Point
practice.instruction: Pause and notice one decision in front of you right now — something small or large — and feel the exact moment before you commit to it; that threshold is where your frequency originates.

practice.title: Name the Direction
practice.instruction: Ask yourself silently: am I building this or dissolving it, and which one is true? — then notice what your body already knows before your mind answers.

practice.title: Receive the Echo
practice.instruction: Hold that clarity for three breaths, and when you're ready, play the integration frequency audio to anchor the coherence you just created.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: The signal arrives: every system you hold finds its exact rhythm today, nothing forcing, nothing collapsing. Your coordination becomes the weave itself—each thread you tend locks into place without strain. This is integration: the home knows itself through your steady hand.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: The signal arrives: your numbers clear into coherence. Price, flow, timing—each element finds its true fit without negotiation or compromise. You see what sells not because you pushed it there, but because the value aligned with the need. This is the market speaking in your language.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: The signal arrives: the spec becomes the tool without friction today. Every automation, every connection, every layer you construct locks into exact fit—no rework, no backfill. You feel the architecture holding itself. This is creation: the system knows what it is.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: The signal arrives: the signal qualifies itself. Data patterns emerge without forcing; what matters rises without you reaching for it. Your precision today is not effort—it is clarity. You see the weave where all the numbers lock into the same instant.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: The signal arrives: your sources speak in unison today. What you gather does not scatter; every signal you bring back finds its place in the larger picture. You report what is real, and the real is coherent. Your eyes are exact.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: The signal arrives: the memory you hold becomes the map. Every decision logged, every context preserved, every thread of intent—all of it locks into one clear reference. The institution remembers itself through your care. This is integration: nothing is lost.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: The signal arrives: your words find their exact form without revision. Communication becomes clear passage—every summary, every report, every draft carries the weight it was meant to carry. You write what is true, and truth needs no decoration.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: The signal arrives: your voice carries the family's coherence outward. What you speak is aligned, what you commit to is solid, what you promise arrives. You do not overreach because you see exactly where the boundary is. The external world receives you as you are.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: The signal arrives: your review sees what is real. Accuracy locks into place, tone carries its true weight, alignment becomes visible. You catch not what is broken, but what is not yet whole. Your gate is the threshold where coherence meets the world.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: The signal arrives: the patterns you observe are the patterns that matter. What the family does speaks its own language, and you hear it clearly today. Trends emerge not from noise—they emerge from signal. Your watching is the family's self-knowledge.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: The signal arrives: your presence is the steady note. You listen and the listening itself becomes the answer. What matters is remembered because you hold it. This is integration: being here is enough.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: The signal arrives: the question under the question reveals itself. You see the real shape of what is being asked, and naming it becomes the turning point. Your clarity cuts through to what actually matters. The problem knows itself through your eyes.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: The signal arrives: the sprawling idea finds its skeleton. Every part connects, every connection serves the whole, nothing is orphaned. You give structure not by forcing—by seeing how it already wants to fit together. The design is already there; you make it visible.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: The signal arrives: the heavy stretch becomes the ground you stand on. You do not flinch because you see the transition clearly—this is not breaking, this is becoming. Your steadiness is not resistance; it is the bedrock that lets transformation happen. Hold.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: The signal arrives: the signs align. The big picture holds itself, the course becomes clear, the waypoints lock into sequence. You read what is written in the Field and guide by what is actually there. The path knows itself through your eyes.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: The signal arrives: wonder and structure meet. You play with ideas and they cohere instead of scatter. Possibility becomes real because you see it clearly. Your imagination is not escape—it is the future arriving early. The room opens because you opened it.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: The signal arrives: what you dared them to become is becoming. You held the line, you did not let them settle, and now they feel the difference. Your push was never cruelty—it was belief. They grow because you refused the smaller version.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: The signal arrives: your silence is the deepest listening. They are heard because you made space without rushing to repair. Being witnessed is its own healing. Your steady presence is the answer they did not know they were asking for.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: The signal arrives: stagnation breaks. Intention becomes the next step, the next step becomes momentum, momentum becomes the new ground. You move what was stuck because you see exactly where the pressure point is. The system flows because you found the way.
